description: Resolve a name at several public resolvers (Google, Cloudflare, Quad9, …) and compare their answers. Use after changing DNS records to check propagation, or when some users reach a different IP or get NXDOMAIN. Use check_email_domain instead for SPF/DKIM/DMARC analysis. Returns per-resolver answers, inconsistencies and a verdict.

domain.description: Domain or hostname to resolve, e.g. www.example.com

type.description: Record type to query. ALL queries the common types at once. Default ALL.

name: check_dns

error.description: Error code when ok is false

ok.description: false when the check could not run (see error / message)

title: DNS lookup across resolvers
